body.x: “Commercialization of the world's first electric vehicle robot charging system"
“80% market share in domestic electric bus charger”
“Doosan delivers Hyundai Wia’s machine tool control system”

Moderntec (CEO Kim Seong-Du) participatedin the world’s largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas onJan. 7-10 and displayed world’s first electric vehicle charging robot system inMIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT located in Eureka Park.

This product is the world's firstintelligent EV charging system and can perform unmanned charging of up to 50electric vehicles with just one robot by changing the charging type and drivingadditional axis.
With this, it is possible to achieve themaximum effect with minimum investment cost, and it can protect the user'ssafety from the high capacity and high voltage charger.

Moderntec is a company with excellenttechnology that supplies machine tool control systems to Doosan and HyundaiWia, and occupies 80% of the market share in the domestic electric bus chargingmarket that requires the most difficulty.

In the electric bus charging market, thecompany makes the bidding directly instead of the public bidding. So, thetechnology, quality, and safety must be met along with price competitiveness.Moreover, because of the high capacity output, the safety of the spark is thefirst priority when power is on and off.

In addition, the company owns a worldpatent technology with its universal charging device that changes chargingmethod according to the change of situations. During the day, intensivecharging method is used since there is only 15 minutes of standby time.However, at night, dispersed charging method is used since multiple vehiclescan be charged at once.

CEO Kim at CES 2020 said, "There wereconstructive meetings with charger platform operators in the US market, and weconfirmed that our patents and technologies in the field of electric vehiclerobot charging are the highest in terms of efficiency. In this show, we havegained the confidence to become no. 1 in price, performance, quality, and allother aspects."

AVING NEWS, the media that has made themost promotion of Korean companies, has set up MIK INNOVATION HOT SPOT in CES2020 Startup Zone EUREKA PARK as the project to help Korean startups to enterthe global market, and will introduce the major Korean startups to the world.
By using the strengths of CES, AVING NEWSintroduced investors, buyers and media Korea’s promising startups throughvarious programs such as strategic consulting, PR marketing, and networkingparties.

MIK Zone was hosted by Next GenerationConvergence Contents Industry Association, AVING NEWS, and MD Insight, andorganized by Bluefoot. It was participated by Changwon Industry PromotionAgency, Incheon Techno Park Startup Support Center, Gwangju University StartupSupport Group, and Sungshin Women's University Startup Support Group.
